observations.note: The energy noticeably rises as the rhythm section intensifies.
Rapid sitar strumming provides a distinct peak before the conclusion.
The sitar remains clearly audible when the heavy guitars enter.
The lead instrument sits comfortably above the dense mix.
The guitar tone is thick and adequately fits the doom metal style.
The rhythm guitars are competent but slightly static in texture.
The rhythm section provides a steady, somewhat mechanical foundation.
Drums and bass are locked but lack organic rhythmic push.
The track abruptly cuts off near the end.
The opening drone and sitar establish a brooding atmosphere.
The fusion of the dark raga with doom instrumentation is effective.

overall_note: The track successfully merges sitar with doom metal, maintaining good lead clarity and a dark atmosphere, though the rhythm section is slightly stiff and the ending is abrupt.
